S109.22.needs: a terminal with the AGI CLI installed; optional: a local model server such as Ollama to see a running state
S109.22.note: The Expected line says the app shows health; here it is a CLI command output, and the TUI /models screen only points to agi models status and does not show health; agi doctor does not check the local runtime.
steps: Open a terminal and type: agi models status, then press Return.
Read the first line of output, which should be "Local model servers".
Look at each provider line: it shows the provider name, "running" or "not running", and the base URL.
If a provider shows "not running", check for the indented "error:" line under it and the models list ("models: none discovered" when nothing is found).
Start a local model server (such as Ollama), run agi models status again, and confirm the line changes to "running" and lists its models.
S109.22.where: Terminal: type "agi models status" (the same check runs with "agi models scan"; add --json for JSON output)
